mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `reaction` set memberId = #{memberId}, relType = #{relType}, relId = #{relId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reaction r LEFT JOIN article a ON r.relType = 'article' AND r.relId = a.id LEFT JOIN reply rp ON r.relType = 'reply' AND r.relId = rp.id WHERE (a.memberId = #{memberId} OR rp.memberId = #{memberId})
